goal: Activate agent work contract enforcement while grandfathering every pre-contract open pull request at its exact current head.
prohibited_actions: Do not retire or weaken the legacy objects alias.
Do not add Agent work contract as a required branch context before enforced mode has remained green for a full day.
Do not grandfather a pull request except at the exact live head observed immediately before activation.
assumptions: Every open pull request without a contract and completion pair can be grandfathered at its exact current head.
The activation PR itself will carry the immutable contract and truthful completion pair.
stop_conditions: Stop if any open pull request without a contract and completion pair is absent from the exact-head grandfather list.
Stop if a listed pull request head moves or closes before the final census is recorded.
Stop if activation requires retiring the legacy objects alias or changing branch protection in this pull request.
